description: ARCHITECT-X Evaluation Benchmark — 20 software requirement cases across 10 domains
note: This dataset is manually editable. Add/modify cases to extend coverage.

cases.name: High-Traffic E-Commerce Platform
cases.requirement: Build an e-commerce platform supporting 100,000 concurrent shoppers with a product catalog of 5 million items, real-time inventory tracking, and checkout processing. Integrate with Stripe for payments. Require sub-200ms product search response time and 99.99% uptime SLA.
expected_concerns: Database connection pool exhaustion under high concurrency
Inventory race conditions during concurrent checkout
Session management scalability
Payment gateway failure handling
expected_decisions: Distributed cache (Redis) for product catalog hot paths
Event-driven inventory updates via message broker
CQRS read/write separation for product queries
Saga pattern for checkout distributed transactions
expected_risks: Overselling due to race conditions
Payment gateway timeout causing order inconsistency
Search index lag during high write throughput

cases.name: Flash Sale Event System
cases.requirement: Design a flash sale system capable of handling 500,000 requests per second during a 30-minute sale event. Products are limited to 1,000 units. Users must not be able to purchase more than allocated. Cart reservation must expire in 10 minutes.
expected_concerns: Thundering herd on sale start
Distributed locking for inventory reservation
Queue fairness and rate limiting per user
expected_decisions: Redis atomic DECR for inventory reservation
Message queue to serialize purchase requests
Per-user rate limiting at API gateway
expected_risks: Redis SPOF for inventory reservation
Queue backlog clearing time exceeding business SLA

cases.name: Real-Time Food Delivery Platform
cases.requirement: Build a food delivery system like Uber Eats supporting 50,000 concurrent active orders, real-time driver location tracking with 5-second update intervals, and restaurant order management. Require push notifications and sub-500ms location update latency.
expected_concerns: High-frequency location write amplification
Fan-out notification at scale
Driver-order matching algorithm performance
expected_decisions: WebSocket or SSE for real-time driver tracking
Geospatial index for driver proximity queries
Event-driven order state machine via message broker
expected_risks: Location data staleness under network partition
Notification delivery failure during load spikes

cases.name: Restaurant Management System
cases.requirement: Create a multi-tenant SaaS platform for restaurant chains to manage menus, orders, kitchen display systems, and analytics. Support 10,000 restaurant tenants with strict data isolation and PCI-DSS compliance for card storage.
expected_concerns: Tenant data isolation and cross-tenant query risk
PCI-DSS compliance requirements for card data
Multi-tenant database schema design
expected_decisions: Row-level security or schema-per-tenant isolation
Tokenization for card data (no direct storage)
Tenant-aware caching to prevent cross-tenant pollution
expected_risks: Noisy neighbor performance degradation
Compliance violation from inadequate data isolation

cases.name: Real-Time Payment Processing System
cases.requirement: Build a payment processing platform handling 10,000 transactions per second with ACID guarantees. Transactions must be idempotent, auditable, and fraud-screened within 100ms. Integrate with 5 bank networks. Require 99.999% availability.
expected_concerns: ACID transaction guarantee at high throughput
Idempotency enforcement to prevent duplicate charges
Fraud detection latency within transaction critical path
Regulatory audit trail immutability
expected_decisions: Event sourcing for immutable audit ledger
Idempotency keys stored in distributed cache
Async fraud scoring with synchronous fallback
Multi-region active-active deployment
expected_risks: Dual-write inconsistency on network partition
Fraud model false-negative rate causing financial loss
Regulatory non-compliance from audit log gaps

cases.name: Digital Wallet & Transfer System
cases.requirement: Design a digital wallet platform allowing peer-to-peer transfers between 20 million registered users with sub-second settlement. Support multi-currency and real-time balance calculation. Require KYC verification integration.
expected_concerns: Distributed ledger consistency on concurrent transfers
Multi-currency exchange rate precision
KYC provider latency in registration flow
expected_decisions: Optimistic locking for balance updates
Separate read replicas for balance inquiry
Asynchronous KYC verification with interim state
expected_risks: Negative balance on concurrent withdrawal
Exchange rate stale data causing incorrect settlement

cases.name: Social Media Feed Platform
cases.requirement: Build a social platform supporting 50 million users with a personalized news feed, 1 billion daily active posts, real-time likes/comments, direct messaging, and content moderation. Feed generation must respond in under 300ms.
expected_concerns: Fan-out write amplification for celebrity users
Feed ranking latency requirements
Real-time event propagation at billion-post scale
Content moderation pipeline throughput
expected_decisions: Pull-based feed for high-follower accounts, push for normal
Graph database for social connections
Eventual consistency for like/comment counters
Async content moderation queue
expected_risks: Fan-out queue backlog causing feed staleness
Harmful content visible during moderation lag

cases.name: Electronic Health Records System
cases.requirement: Design a HIPAA-compliant EHR system for 500 hospitals with 10 million patient records. Support clinical decision support, medication management, and real-time lab result integration. All data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Audit logs required for every record access.
expected_concerns: HIPAA compliance for PHI data handling
Encryption key management at scale
Comprehensive audit logging for all PHI access
High availability for clinical-critical operations
expected_decisions: Field-level encryption for PII/PHI fields
Immutable append-only audit log (write-once storage)
Role-based access control with minimum necessary principle
Break-glass emergency access procedure
expected_risks: PHI data breach due to insufficient access controls
Clinical decision system unavailability causing patient harm
Audit log tampering compromising compliance evidence

cases.name: Telemedicine Video Consultation Platform
cases.requirement: Build a telemedicine platform supporting 100,000 concurrent video consultations with end-to-end encryption, session recording for medical compliance, and integration with pharmacy and insurance systems. Require GDPR and HIPAA compliance.
expected_concerns: Media server capacity for 100k concurrent streams
End-to-end encryption key exchange
Recording storage and retention compliance
Network quality degradation handling
expected_decisions: WebRTC for peer-to-peer video with TURN server fallback
Separate media recording pipeline from live stream
Session-based ephemeral encryption keys
expected_risks: Regulatory violation from unencrypted session recordings
TURN server bottleneck under high concurrent load

cases.name: Global Supply Chain Tracking System
cases.requirement: Build a logistics tracking platform for 1 million active shipments across 150 countries. Support real-time location updates from IoT devices every 30 seconds, customs clearance integrations, and SLA breach alerts.
expected_concerns: High-frequency IoT write throughput
Global latency for 150-country coverage
Third-party customs API reliability
SLA breach detection at stream processing layer
expected_decisions: Time-series database for shipment location events
Stream processing (Kafka Streams/Flink) for SLA monitoring
Multi-region deployment with CDN for API responses
Circuit breaker for customs API integrations
expected_risks: IoT device clock drift causing event ordering issues
Customs API downtime blocking clearance workflow

cases.name: Last-Mile Delivery Optimization
cases.requirement: Design a delivery route optimization system for 10,000 delivery drivers with real-time traffic integration, dynamic re-routing, and proof-of-delivery capture. Target 98% on-time delivery rate.
expected_concerns: Route optimization algorithm latency
Real-time traffic data API reliability
Offline capability for drivers in low-connectivity zones
expected_decisions: Hybrid online/offline mobile app architecture
Async route recalculation triggered by traffic events
Event sourcing for proof-of-delivery chain of custody
expected_risks: Optimization service unavailability degrading delivery SLA
Offline data sync conflicts on reconnection

cases.name: Video Streaming Platform
cases.requirement: Build a video streaming service supporting 10 million concurrent viewers with adaptive bitrate streaming, content personalization, and global CDN delivery. Support 4K content and require less than 2-second startup latency.
expected_concerns: Origin server throughput for 10M concurrent streams
CDN cache miss cost during content launches
Adaptive bitrate algorithm performance
Content protection (DRM) latency
expected_decisions: Multi-CDN strategy for global coverage
Pre-warm CDN on scheduled content releases
Widevine/FairPlay DRM integration
Separate recommendation microservice with async ML updates
expected_risks: CDN provider outage causing global service unavailability
DRM license server latency exceeding startup budget

cases.name: Live Events Streaming Platform
cases.requirement: Design a live sports/event streaming platform handling 5 million simultaneous viewers per event with sub-10 second stream latency and real-time chat. Require viewer authentication and pay-per-view access control.
expected_concerns: Flash crowd spike at event start time
Low-latency streaming vs CDN cache compatibility
Real-time chat message fan-out at scale
expected_decisions: WebRTC or CMAF-LL for low latency live segments
Separate scalable chat service from video pipeline
Pre-scaling infrastructure 30 minutes before event
expected_risks: Inadequate pre-scaling causing event start service degradation
CDN cache invalidation lag during live stream recovery

cases.name: Online Learning Management System
cases.requirement: Build an LMS supporting 2 million students with live video classes, quizzes with automatic grading, progress tracking, and certificate generation. Integrate with Zoom for live sessions. Require accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA).
expected_concerns: Synchronous video integration with third-party provider
Auto-grading accuracy and latency
Certificate generation and fraud prevention
expected_decisions: Third-party video integration via webhook-driven session management
Background worker queue for certificate generation
Separate read model for progress dashboards (CQRS)
expected_risks: Video provider downtime during scheduled live sessions
Auto-grading engine errors affecting student records

cases.name: Adaptive Learning AI Platform
cases.requirement: Design an AI-powered adaptive learning platform that personalizes curriculum paths for 500,000 learners in real-time based on performance and engagement signals. Integrate ML model inference within the question delivery loop.
expected_concerns: ML inference latency within interactive user flow
Model retraining without downtime
Personalization data privacy (FERPA/COPPA for minors)
expected_decisions: Async ML model scoring with cached recommendations
Shadow deployment for model canary rollouts
Differential privacy for training data aggregation
expected_risks: Model bias leading to discriminatory learning paths
Inference service latency spike degrading user experience

cases.name: Multi-Tenant SaaS CRM Platform
cases.requirement: Build a multi-tenant CRM SaaS platform for 10,000 enterprise customers with custom workflows, email automation (5 million emails/day), and Salesforce/HubSpot integrations. Require SOC 2 Type II compliance.
expected_concerns: Multi-tenant data isolation with SOC 2 compliance
Email sending throughput and delivery rate
Noisy neighbor resource contention between tenants
Integration reliability with external CRM systems
expected_decisions: Tenant namespace isolation with per-tenant encryption keys
Dedicated email sending infrastructure with IP warming
Per-tenant rate limiting and resource quotas
Circuit breaker for external CRM API integrations
expected_risks: Email deliverability degradation from shared IP reputation
Data leakage across tenant boundaries

cases.name: Developer Platform & API Gateway
cases.requirement: Design a developer API platform offering 20 core APIs to third-party developers. Support 500 million API calls/day, granular per-API-key rate limiting, usage analytics, and billing by consumption. Require SLA of 99.95% for premium tier.
expected_concerns: Rate limiting at billion-API-call scale
Per-key usage metering accuracy for billing
API versioning and backward compatibility
DDoS protection at ingress layer
expected_decisions: Distributed token bucket in Redis for per-key rate limiting
Kafka-based event stream for usage metering
API gateway abstraction layer for versioning
Anycast DDoS mitigation at edge
expected_risks: Metering data loss causing billing inaccuracies
Rate limiter Redis SPOF allowing quota bypass

cases.name: Smart City IoT Data Platform
cases.requirement: Build an IoT data ingestion and analytics platform for a smart city with 500,000 connected sensors (traffic, air quality, energy). Ingest 1 million events per second, store 5 years of historical data, and provide real-time dashboards.
expected_concerns: 1M events/second ingestion throughput
Time-series data storage efficiency for 5-year retention
Real-time aggregation latency for dashboards
Device authentication at scale
expected_decisions: Apache Kafka for high-throughput event ingestion
TimescaleDB or InfluxDB for time-series storage
Stream processing for real-time aggregations
mTLS device authentication at IoT gateway
expected_risks: Sensor data flood causing Kafka consumer lag
Cascading failure if stream processing falls behind

cases.name: Industrial Equipment Monitoring System
cases.requirement: Design a predictive maintenance system for 10,000 industrial machines generating sensor data every 100ms. Detect anomalies in real-time and trigger maintenance alerts within 30 seconds of anomaly detection. Require offline operation during network outages.
expected_concerns: Edge processing for sub-second anomaly detection
Offline data buffering during connectivity loss
Alert fatigue from high false-positive ML models
Secure OTA firmware updates for edge devices
expected_decisions: Edge compute (fog computing) for local anomaly detection
Store-and-forward buffer on edge devices
Dual-layer anomaly detection (edge + cloud ML)
Signed firmware updates over TLS
expected_risks: Data loss during extended network partition
ML model drift causing missed anomaly detections

cases.name: Generic Microservices Migration
cases.requirement: Migrate an existing monolithic Java Spring Boot application serving 20,000 daily users to a microservices architecture. The monolith handles user management, product catalog, order processing, and reporting. Require zero-downtime migration and backward compatibility.
expected_concerns: Distributed transaction management replacing monolith transactions
Data ownership boundary definition between services
Strangler fig migration risks
Service mesh communication overhead
expected_decisions: Strangler fig pattern for incremental decomposition
Saga pattern to replace cross-module transactions
API gateway for backward-compatible routing
Shared database elimination through database-per-service
expected_risks: Increased operational complexity from 1 to N services
Network latency regression compared to in-process calls
